scope: QR-2 gap-interval source qualification and staged design
findings: Sparse valuation predecessor rows do not establish complete range coverage. A separate bounded coverage read is required.
BARS assembleGaps can be reused through a validated adapter; chart history clipping and latest-bar anchoring cannot be reused.
SQL read time is outside the worker deadline. Account and owner work require aggregate input/output budgets and local cost evidence.
rootDecisions: Inspect full closed candles only, exposing excluded partial edges. Preserve separate price lookup and option M.
Closed state/identity/interval schema; unsupported market is null and takes precedence over empty-domain states.
No silent truncation or range shortening; coverage resource overflow is a whole-request admission refusal.
Complete feature includes account and owner publication, shared coverage work, both response validators and EN/TH rendering.
Only the pure adapter, validator and mechanical BARS extraction are admitted now. Numerical budgets, DB integration and target effects are not admitted.

checks.method: Independent source review, BARS reuse investigation, coherent design and adversarial review; no tests or runtime executed
